blockingFindings.title: R1 boundary matrix is incomplete
blockingFindings.rationale: A generic lifecycle path or multi-value parser could pass the current tests while violating the dedicated query dispatch contract.
blockingFindings.issue: Only valid stdin, valid request-file input, direct stdin, and one competing-input case are covered. Missing cases include absent input, scalar/array JSON, trailing or multiple values, MAX_REQUEST_BYTES, and invalid request-file paths. No test observes early validation before worktree, container, logger, config, ambient Flow, or hooks.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add explicit boundary rejection cases and pre-bootstrap probes for both entrypoints, including root/source handoff and success/failure lifecycle suppression.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: A generic lifecycle path or multi-value parser could pass the current tests while violating the dedicated query dispatch contract.

blockingFindings.title: R2 does not test the plain-object and exact-shape contract
blockingFindings.rationale: The implementation could accept non-object requests or invalid selectors without any spec-local test failing.
blockingFindings.issue: The test does not reject scalar/array/null requests, invalid resource or condition types, missing or whitespace-only specId, or unsafe/non-positive flowVersion values.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add cases for every invalid top-level/resource/condition shape and the complete specId and flowVersion boundary matrix.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: The implementation could accept non-object requests or invalid selectors without any spec-local test failing.

blockingFindings.title: Canonical version integrity and bound handling are not covered
blockingFindings.rationale: Version discovery and record validation are core safety boundaries; an implementation can skip them and still pass the current selection assertions.
blockingFindings.issue: The manually copied Version 2 fixture is only used to verify selection. There are no tests for duplicate versions, available-version overflow, truncation rejection, directory/state identity mismatch, unsupported independent revisions, malformed envelopes, or state/result version confusion.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add canonical fixtures that independently corrupt each identity/revision and exceed enumeration limits, asserting the required canonical error and no fallback.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: Version discovery and record validation are core safety boundaries; an implementation can skip them and still pass the current selection assertions.

blockingFindings.title: Response-size enforcement is untested
blockingFindings.rationale: The current tests cannot detect violation of the required MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES and no-truncation guarantees.
blockingFindings.issue: The metadata success test uses a small fixture and never creates an available-version list or public response exceeding its configured byte limit.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add over-limit fixtures and assert that oversized results fail canonically rather than succeeding or being silently truncated.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: The current tests cannot detect violation of the required MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES and no-truncation guarantees.

blockingFindings.title: Metadata derivation and blocker precedence lack regression coverage
blockingFindings.rationale: Incorrect live-Git/timestamp fallback or blocker derivation can pass all current assertions while exposing non-canonical data.
blockingFindings.issue: The tests cover only a missing Git snapshot, one failure-derived blocker, and one finalized timestamp set. They do not cover validated Git snapshots, issue relationships, capabilities fallback prevention, unavailable timestamps, observation exclusion, persisted blocker precedence, failure fallback, failure-disposition fallback, or the required inconsistency when all blocker sources are empty.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add canonical fixture variants for each source and precedence branch, including observation-only ledgers and no-evidence timestamps.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: Incorrect live-Git/timestamp fallback or blocker derivation can pass all current assertions while exposing non-canonical data.

blockingFindings.title: R6 asserts an unspecified provenance literal
blockingFindings.rationale: A compliant implementation using a different valid provenance string would be rejected by this test.
blockingFindings.issue: The test requires createdAt.provenance to equal "activity.timing.finishedAt", but the requirement only fixes provenance as a non-empty string and does not fix that literal.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Assert the required non-empty provenance and availability relationships, or use a provenance value explicitly fixed by the public contract.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: A compliant implementation using a different valid provenance string would be rejected by this test.

blockingFindings.title: Artifact reference and integrity boundaries are largely untested
blockingFindings.rationale: An implementation could return stored IDs, infer relations from paths, expose unsupported fields, or skip integrity limits while passing the current test.
blockingFindings.issue: Only one catalog descriptor's hash is checked. There are no cases for path/logical/catalog-pair lookup, optional versus canonical unresolved references, migrationMaterialization, logical contract schemaRevision, canonical JSON depth/size/cycle failures, relation mapping, or collection limits.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add catalog and Activity fixtures covering each reference kind, relation outcome, descriptor integrity boundary, and required canonical failure.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: An implementation could return stored IDs, infer relations from paths, expose unsupported fields, or skip integrity limits while passing the current test.

blockingFindings.title: Bounded reader and side-effect-free guarantees are not statically exercised
blockingFindings.rationale: The current snapshots can pass even if the reader uses materializing APIs, reads beyond bounds, follows symlinks, or changes Git state.
blockingFindings.issue: Tree snapshots only compare regular files under the temporary root. They do not verify O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW behavior, symlink/regular-file identity, per-record byte limits, confirmed-prefix parsing, unreadable versus inconsistent classification, forbidden store/runtime construction, hook suppression, or Git status. The before/after status check is Flow status, not Git status.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add direct reader tests and observable sentinels for each reader entrypoint, malformed filesystem fixture, forbidden API, hook, runtime, cache, lock, temporary, and Git mutation path.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: The current snapshots can pass even if the reader uses materializing APIs, reads beyond bounds, follows symlinks, or changes Git state.

blockingFindings.title: Cursor tests accept arbitrary pagination tokens and use an invalid mismatch target
blockingFindings.rationale: An offset cursor or weakly validated token could satisfy the current assertions, and the nonexistent-spec case does not isolate CURSOR_QUERY_MISMATCH behavior.
blockingFindings.issue: The test only checks that a returned string advances pagination and that one malformed token fails. It does not validate canonical payload encoding, digest, exact bindings, reuse, invalid order/types, or offset exclusion. Its mismatch case uses a nonexistent spec, conflating cursor mismatch with spec lookup.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Create a second valid spec/version, mutate each cursor payload field and digest, test reuse and all mismatch dimensions, and assert the canonical cursor representation rather than only pagination advancement.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: An offset cursor or weakly validated token could satisfy the current assertions, and the nonexistent-spec case does not isolate CURSOR_QUERY_MISMATCH behavior.

blockingFindings.title: Activity projection semantics are only structurally checked
blockingFindings.rationale: A projection that leaks stored references or selects/merges invalid attempt data could pass the current structural assertions.
blockingFindings.issue: The fixture does not exercise usage cost provenance, failure/outcome projection, artifact reference resolution, activity blocker/incomplete sourcing, multiple incomplete claims, metric/note fields, or collection limits. The helper mostly checks key names and a few primitive values.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add confirmed Activity fixtures for every non-null component, source precedence, unresolved-reference outcome, and collection/incomplete cardinality rule.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: A projection that leaks stored references or selects/merges invalid attempt data could pass the current structural assertions.

blockingFindings.title: Error classification and public-path matrix is incomplete
blockingFindings.rationale: The implementation can misclassify canonical failures or leak internal paths without any current test detecting it.
blockingFindings.issue: Only invalid JSON, missing spec, one broken state, an unknown top-level field, and one resource-incompatible field are checked. Missing are unreadable versus inconsistent file failures, missing records, invalid flow-version selection, all public JSON-pointer paths, complete internal-name redaction, and known-resource envelopes for the remaining failure branches.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add an error matrix covering every required code/path/classification and both resources, with assertions that no internal storage path, filename, catalog key, or lock name is exposed.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: The implementation can misclassify canonical failures or leak internal paths without any current test detecting it.

blockingFindings.title: R15 does not establish the shared reader boundary
blockingFindings.rationale: A Version 1-only or migration-dependent implementation can pass the current public-shape comparison.
blockingFindings.issue: It queries activities from one manually copied Version 2 fixture and compares public envelopes. It does not cover fresh versus migrated flows, metadata/artifact reads across versions, Version 1 direct records versus Version 2 envelopes, or prove that the same bounded reader is used without a Version 1 facade or migration report.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add fresh and migrated fixtures and exercise state, Spec, ledger, catalog, metadata, and activities through the same reader boundary, including instrumentation or targeted module tests for forbidden legacy APIs.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: A Version 1-only or migration-dependent implementation can pass the current public-shape comparison.

blockingFindings.title: Migration-parity inventory is absent
blockingFindings.rationale: The stated migration-parity acceptance requirement has no corresponding spec-local coverage beyond a superficial help/status comparison.
blockingFindings.issue: The test compares help and status output before and after one query and checks command names in help. It does not preserve or verify the required route/args, prepare/resume/run lifecycle, config/target resolution, hooks, generated artifacts, authority, or lock/cache/temporary/Git behavior inventory.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add an explicit owner/behavior/regression mapping fixture and executable checks for every listed existing public behavior.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: The stated migration-parity acceptance requirement has no corresponding spec-local coverage beyond a superficial help/status comparison.

blockingFindings.title: Reader module path and export are not specified
blockingFindings.rationale: A conforming implementation with different module organization is rejected before query behavior is exercised.
blockingFindings.issue: The tests require src/flow/lib/canonical-flow-version-reader.js and a named CanonicalFlowVersionReader export, but the requirements specify neither module path nor export shape.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Either fix the specification with this module contract or test through a specified public boundary without assuming this path/export.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: A conforming implementation with different module organization is rejected before query behavior is exercised.

blockingFindings.title: Version 2 fixture contradicts the required state identity format
blockingFindings.rationale: A correct reader must reject the current Version 2 fixture, while a reader that ignores the inner identity binding can pass.
blockingFindings.issue: addVersionTwo() copies Version 1 state into the Version 2 envelope without setting inner state.flowVersion. R15 requires that value and its exact match with the directory version. The negative cases also never corrupt inner state.flowVersion.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Build a valid Version 2 fixture with inner flowVersion: 2 and add a mismatch regression; add direct Version 1 validation regressions through the same reader.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: A correct reader must reject the current Version 2 fixture, while a reader that ignores the inner identity binding can pass.

blockingFindings.title: Cursor test invents an unspecified digest contract
blockingFindings.rationale: A compliant opaque cursor implementation using a different specified digest representation would be rejected.
blockingFindings.issue: The test requires exact cursor keys including digest and assumes sorted-key JSON plus SHA-256 over the unsigned payload. R10 does not define that field, digest algorithm, or canonicalization algorithm.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Restrict assertions to cursor fields and encoding fixed by the requirements, or explicitly specify the complete digest payload contract before testing it.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: A compliant opaque cursor implementation using a different specified digest representation would be rejected.

blockingFindings.title: Tests hardcode limits whose numeric values are not fixed
blockingFindings.target: tests/flow-query-api.test.js: MAX_* declarations and overflow cases in R1/R4/R7/R8
blockingFindings.rationale: A conforming implementation with different specified limits would fail these tests, and the coverage artifact would not be specification-grounded.
blockingFindings.issue: The tests assume exact values for MAX_REQUEST_BYTES, MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES, MAX_AVAILABLE_FLOW_VERSIONS, MAX_ARTIFACTS, collection limits, record byte limits, and related bounds, but the supplied requirements only name most of these limits.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Define every tested numeric limit in the specification or obtain it from a fixed public contract; otherwise test relative boundary behavior without invented values.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: A conforming implementation with different specified limits would fail these tests, and the coverage artifact would not be specification-grounded.

blockingFindings.title: Request-file boundary coverage is incomplete
blockingFindings.target: tests/flow-query-api.test.js: R1 requestFilePath and boundaryCases loops
blockingFindings.rationale: Required R1 path-validation and root/source handoff branches can be absent while the claimed R1 coverage still passes.
blockingFindings.issue: The tests cover missing, directory, and empty paths, but not a successful normalized-relative path, an unreadable regular file, duplicate request-file options, or NUL handling at a parser boundary. invoke() also always supplies work/source bindings, so the no-binding fallback is untested.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add those request-file and binding cases, using a parser-level fixture for NUL if the OS cannot carry NUL in argv.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: Required R1 path-validation and root/source handoff branches can be absent while the claimed R1 coverage still passes.

blockingFindings.title: Metadata blocker fallback precedence is not fully tested
blockingFindings.rationale: Incorrect blocker precedence or live Git derivation can pass the current tests.
blockingFindings.issue: The tests cover persisted blocker, current failure, and empty sources, but never cover the required failure-disposition reason fallback. They also test missing gitSnapshot only outside a real Git repository, so live-Git fallback is not excluded.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add fixtures with only a non-empty failure-disposition reason and with an initialized Git repository lacking gitSnapshot; assert the exact fallback and unavailable Git result.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: Incorrect blocker precedence or live Git derivation can pass the current tests.

blockingFindings.title: Timestamp tests do not enforce the complete evidence rule
blockingFindings.rationale: An implementation that counts record_nonblocking or any create_flow type can pass despite violating R6.
blockingFindings.issue: createdAt is selected by operation without checking type === flow_created, and only record_metric/record_note are tested as observations; record_nonblocking is never placed after a state-changing Activity. The filter set is therefore only partially regression-tested.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add a wrong-type create_flow case and a later record_nonblocking case, asserting the required unavailable/unchanged timestamps.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: An implementation that counts record_nonblocking or any create_flow type can pass despite violating R6.

blockingFindings.title: Activities filtering does not prove timing.finishedAt authority
blockingFindings.target: tests/flow-query-api.test.js: R9 applies the default page and finishedAt datetime filter
blockingFindings.rationale: A filesystem-time implementation or permissive boundary parser can pass the current tests.
blockingFindings.issue: The only filter assertion uses a future empty range, which would also pass if filtering used filesystem timestamps. Exact page and recordedAt object rejection is also not tested for extra or missing fields.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Set filesystem mtimes independently from Activity timing.finishedAt and assert filtering follows timing; add exact-shape and unknown-field cases for page and recordedAt.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: A filesystem-time implementation or permissive boundary parser can pass the current tests.

blockingFindings.title: Static substring checks do not enforce the reader boundary
blockingFindings.target: tests/flow-query-api.test.js: R15/R16 readerSource.includes() checks and stderr substring checks
blockingFindings.rationale: The critical side-effect and initialization invariants have no reliable behavioral regression test.
blockingFindings.issue: Absence of owner names in source and absence of diagnostic words in stderr do not prove that stores, runtime, config events, logger sinks, or ambient-flow resolution were not invoked. Aliased or dynamic calls can pass, and silent calls are invisible.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Use a fixed injectable seam or call-level probes for forbidden constructors/events and assert zero calls across successful and failed query paths.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: The critical side-effect and initialization invariants have no reliable behavioral regression test.

blockingFindings.title: Migration-parity coverage is mostly declarative or help-only
blockingFindings.target: tests/flow-query-api.test.js: R17 inventory and parity test
blockingFindings.rationale: Query changes could remove or alter existing behavior while all current R17 assertions still pass.
blockingFindings.issue: Owner-file existence, function type checks, help/args checks, and selected prepare/status/context/resume calls do not execute the inventoried run lifecycle, task, review, gate, finalize, hook error-policy, or most artifact/config behavior.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add executable regression coverage for each inventoried category, especially hook invocation/order/error handling and gate/review/finalize behavior, with observable artifact and side-effect assertions.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: Query changes could remove or alter existing behavior while all current R17 assertions still pass.

advisoryFindings.title: Repeated test IDs reduce failure localization
advisoryFindings.target: tests/flow-query-api.test.js: repeated R3, R7, R8, R11, and R16 test names
advisoryFindings.rationale: This affects review and failure diagnostics only, not executable correctness.
advisoryFindings.improvement: Use unique case identifiers or suffixes for each repeated requirement test.
advisoryFindings.whyNonBlocking: This affects review and failure diagnostics only, not executable correctness.

blockingFindings.title: Request-file content validation is untested
blockingFindings.rationale: R1 requires identical exactly-one-object validation for both input sources.
blockingFindings.issue: Malformed JSON, trailing/multiple values, oversized input, and boundary-field validation are exercised only through stdin; request-file is tested only for path handling and one valid file.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Exercise representative content-validation cases through --request-file and assert the same boundary envelopes.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R1 requires identical exactly-one-object validation for both input sources.

blockingFindings.title: R6 test expects the wrong updatedAt behavior
blockingFindings.target: tests/flow-query-api.test.js: R6 wrong-type create_flow and observation-only cases
blockingFindings.rationale: The test directly contradicts the required timestamp derivation and would reject a conforming implementation.
blockingFindings.issue: The tests expect updatedAt to be unavailable when create_flow has the wrong type or when only observation activities are appended. create_flow remains in the explicitly listed state-changing operation set, so its timing.finishedAt must supply updatedAt.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Assert updatedAt is available from the confirmed create_flow Activity; only createdAt should become unavailable when its type is not flow_created.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: The test directly contradicts the required timestamp derivation and would reject a conforming implementation.

blockingFindings.title: Cursor replay assertion contradicts R10
blockingFindings.rationale: A conforming implementation would fail this test.
blockingFindings.issue: The test expects reusing the same cursor query to succeed and return the same response, while R10 classifies a cursor reused in a query as CURSOR_QUERY_MISMATCH.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Change the replay case to assert CURSOR_QUERY_MISMATCH, consistent with R10's stated reuse rule.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: A conforming implementation would fail this test.

blockingFindings.title: Cursor canonical digest is not verified
blockingFindings.rationale: An implementation can omit cursor integrity validation while all current R10 tests pass.
blockingFindings.issue: The tests check base64url round-tripping and selected binding fields but never require or validate the cursor's canonical digest, canonical serialization, or missing/incorrect digest rejection.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Assert the specified canonical digest/integrity representation and add tampered, missing, and non-canonical payload cases expecting INVALID_CURSOR.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: An implementation can omit cursor integrity validation while all current R10 tests pass.

blockingFindings.title: Shared reader boundary is asserted only by output equivalence
blockingFindings.target: tests/flow-query-api.test.js: R15 shared-reader test and createQueryCallProbe
blockingFindings.rationale: R15 makes the shared non-migration reader architecture and entrypoints a required invariant, not merely an output requirement.
blockingFindings.issue: The test does not observe CanonicalFlowVersionReader construction or its required entrypoints, so separate Version 1 and Version 2 readers or a Version 1 facade can pass while producing equivalent output.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Instrument the fixed reader boundary and assert both Version 1 and Version 2+ state, Spec, ledger, and catalog reads use the same bounded reader entrypoints, with no legacy facade.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R15 makes the shared non-migration reader architecture and entrypoints a required invariant, not merely an output requirement.

blockingFindings.title: Replay assertion requires cross-process state
blockingFindings.target: R10 test: `it("R10: validates opaque cursor payloads, replay, bindings, and pagination position", ...)`
blockingFindings.rationale: This rejects a correct stateless implementation and would force forbidden persistent replay state.
blockingFindings.issue: The test invokes a new CLI process twice with the same request and cursor, then expects the second invocation to return `CURSOR_QUERY_MISMATCH`. A side-effect-free CLI has no state with which to distinguish these invocations.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Remove the one-time replay expectation or replace it with a stateless binding/position mismatch case. A one-use cursor requires an explicitly stateful API contract.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: This rejects a correct stateless implementation and would force forbidden persistent replay state.

blockingFindings.title: Migration-parity inventory is not executable coverage
blockingFindings.rationale: R17 requires an observable migration-parity mapping for every retained public surface, and the current tests leave major regressions undetected.
blockingFindings.issue: The inventory claims coverage for every lifecycle, task, review, gate, finalize, config, target, hook, and canonical-artifact behavior, but executable command tests cover only a subset. Most lifecycle routes are checked only for registry presence/help/args, which would pass even if their behavior or artifact/side-effect contracts were removed.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add executable regressions for each inventoried behavior, or narrow the inventory to the behaviors actually tested; route metadata checks alone are insufficient for R17.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R17 requires an observable migration-parity mapping for every retained public surface, and the current tests leave major regressions undetected.

blockingFindings.title: The exact timestamp operation set is not regression-tested
blockingFindings.target: R6 test: `it("R6: sources Timestamp availability only from confirmed state-changing Activity timing", ...)`
blockingFindings.rationale: An implementation can use an incomplete or incorrect operation set while all current assertions still pass.
blockingFindings.issue: The test redeclares the required operation set but the fixtures exercise only a small subset (`create_flow`, `finalize_flow`, and a few observation operations). The computed `updated` value therefore does not detect omission or misclassification of most listed state-changing operations.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add table-driven canonical ledger fixtures for every listed state-changing operation and explicit observation cases, asserting that each included operation updates timestamps and each excluded operation does not.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: An implementation can use an incomplete or incorrect operation set while all current assertions still pass.

blockingFindings.title: Side-effect checks do not cover canonical-error paths
blockingFindings.target: R16 test: `it("R16: leaves canonical files, runtime side effects, and Git state unchanged on success and failure", ...)`
blockingFindings.rationale: A query implementation could create logs, locks, cache, or temporary files only while handling canonical failures and still pass the current R16 coverage.
blockingFindings.issue: The side-effect test covers one success and `FLOW_VERSION_NOT_FOUND`, and only through the top-level entrypoint. Missing, malformed, symlinked, unreadable, digest/schema-inconsistent, and response-limit failures are tested elsewhere without before/after side-effect assertions.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Run representative canonical read/integrity failures through both `src/sennel.js` and direct `src/flow.js`, comparing the full tree, Git status, runtime state, and probes before and after each failure.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: A query implementation could create logs, locks, cache, or temporary files only while handling canonical failures and still pass the current R16 coverage.

blockingFindings.title: stderr diagnostic routing is never asserted
blockingFindings.rationale: The diagnostic-channel and single-stdout-document requirements have no executable coverage.
blockingFindings.issue: `assertBoundaryError` and `assertKnownError` inspect the JSON response but do not assert that diagnostics are emitted on stderr, that stdout contains only the response document, or that successful queries leave stderr clean.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add raw stdout/stderr assertions for representative boundary, canonical, and success paths, including the required stderr-only diagnostic behavior.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: The diagnostic-channel and single-stdout-document requirements have no executable coverage.

blockingFindings.title: Activity schema assertions are incomplete
blockingFindings.rationale: A malformed public Activity schema can pass the current tests despite violating R11.
blockingFindings.issue: The helper mostly checks key presence. It does not validate the required scalar types, enums, positive/non-negative bounds, ISO-8601 values, or nested shapes for all non-null `outcome`, `metric`, `tokens`, `artifactRefs`, and related fields across returned items.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Make the ActivityItem assertions recursively validate every public field and add fixtures covering each non-null component and its boundary values.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: A malformed public Activity schema can pass the current tests despite violating R11.

blockingFindings.title: Missing-source blocked state does not test the required canonical error
blockingFindings.rationale: The required no-source error path is untested and can silently return an invented or empty blocker.
blockingFindings.issue: The fallback case leaves the definition-provided failure-disposition reason intact and expects it to be used. There is no fixture where the persisted blocker, failure code/message, and disposition reason are all absent while `nextAction.operation` is `blocked`.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add a fixture that removes all three sources and assert `CANONICAL_RECORD_INCONSISTENT` with the resource-specific empty projection.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: The required no-source error path is untested and can silently return an invented or empty blocker.

blockingFindings.title: Versioned canonical validation coverage is incomplete
blockingFindings.rationale: R3/R15 can regress in a version-specific or discovery-specific path while the current mutation cases continue to pass.
blockingFindings.issue: The tests cover several envelope, state, ledger-contiguity, and catalog mutations, but do not independently exercise every required Spec/ledger/catalog revision validator or discovery filtering against unrelated Spec directories. The available-version overflow fixture also uses empty directories, so the error is not isolated to enumeration overflow.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add independent corruption cases for every supported revision and identity binding, an unrelated-Spec discovery fixture, and a valid-record overflow fixture that proves enumeration is rejected rather than failing due to missing records.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R3/R15 can regress in a version-specific or discovery-specific path while the current mutation cases continue to pass.

advisoryFindings.title: Add valid identifier boundary cases
advisoryFindings.rationale: Invalid and ordinary valid identifiers are already covered.
advisoryFindings.improvement: Include valid identifiers using dots, underscores, and hyphens, plus the shortest valid form, to pin the accepted format positively.
advisoryFindings.whyNonBlocking: Invalid and ordinary valid identifiers are already covered.

advisoryFindings.title: Avoid duplicate requirement IDs in test names
advisoryFindings.target: R3, R7, R11, and R15 test names
advisoryFindings.rationale: This affects traceability only, not executable behavior.
advisoryFindings.improvement: Use unique TC identifiers or descriptive suffixes so coverage reports can distinguish the separate cases.
advisoryFindings.whyNonBlocking: This affects traceability only, not executable behavior.

advisoryFindings.title: Parsing prose to obtain limits is brittle
advisoryFindings.rationale: The current helper still derives limits from the immutable spec artifact and does not inherently invalidate the tests.
advisoryFindings.improvement: Prefer a dedicated machine-readable test contract or explicit fixture constants synchronized with the specification.
advisoryFindings.whyNonBlocking: The current helper still derives limits from the immutable spec artifact and does not inherently invalidate the tests.

blockingFindings.title: Migration-parity baseline is self-referential
blockingFindings.target: R17: preserves the inventoried owners and behavior of every existing Flow surface
blockingFindings.rationale: R17 requires regression coverage for existing public routes; this test can pass without preserving production behavior.
blockingFindings.issue: runCommands is derived from the current FLOW_COMMANDS.run, and legacy snapshots are captured after implementation. Removing an unlisted existing route or changing its help/args can therefore pass.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Use an immutable pre-query route/help/args inventory covering every retained Flow command and assert the current registry against it.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R17 requires regression coverage for existing public routes; this test can pass without preserving production behavior.

blockingFindings.title: Hook tests bypass command lifecycle wiring
blockingFindings.target: R17: executes every retained lifecycle hook and preserves priority and error policy
blockingFindings.rationale: Lifecycle pre/post/error attachment is an acceptance requirement, but direct runner tests do not exercise production command behavior.
blockingFindings.issue: The test directly calls discoverFlowCommandHooks/runFlowCommandHooks with synthetic contexts. Only prepare has an actual command-level hook assertion; gate, review, and finalize wiring can be removed while these tests still pass.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Invoke each retained command with installed hooks, including representative success and error paths, and assert the registered callbacks execute through the command route.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: Lifecycle pre/post/error attachment is an acceptance requirement, but direct runner tests do not exercise production command behavior.

blockingFindings.title: Bootstrap ordering is not observed
blockingFindings.target: R1: accepts exactly one stdin or request-file object through both public entrypoints
blockingFindings.rationale: R1 explicitly requires request parsing and validation to be the first I/O and forbids pre-bootstrap initialization.
blockingFindings.issue: The probes reject selected container/manager calls and Git discovery, but do not observe config reads or establish that request parsing and boundary validation precede every configuration/bootstrap I/O.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add an ordering probe or fail-fast fixture proving malformed/oversized input returns the boundary error before config, logger, attribution, or canonical-root reads occur.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R1 explicitly requires request parsing and validation to be the first I/O and forbids pre-bootstrap initialization.

blockingFindings.title: Confirmed-prefix bounded reading is not verified
blockingFindings.target: R8: classifies missing or symlinked records and stops at the confirmed ledger prefix
blockingFindings.rationale: The test does not catch a violation of the required bounded confirmed-prefix reader behavior.
blockingFindings.issue: The sentinel records open flags but not read offsets or lengths. A reader can read the malformed ledger suffix and then ignore it, while the test still passes.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Record canonical file read ranges and assert that ledger reads stop at the confirmed prefix boundary.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: The test does not catch a violation of the required bounded confirmed-prefix reader behavior.

blockingFindings.title: Side-effect regression coverage omits failed activities queries
blockingFindings.target: R16: leaves canonical files, runtime state, Git, and probes unchanged on canonical failures
blockingFindings.rationale: R16 requires side-effect freedom on all successful and failed query paths, including both public resources.
blockingFindings.issue: The side-effect snapshot matrix invokes only metadata failures. A resource-specific activities failure path could mutate files, runtime state, Git, or invoke lifecycle code without being detected.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Run the same success/failure side-effect assertions for activities, including unreadable, inconsistent, and response-limit cases where applicable.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R16 requires side-effect freedom on all successful and failed query paths, including both public resources.

blockingFindings.title: Artifact collection overflow enforcement is untested
blockingFindings.target: R7: enforces canonical artifact identity size/depth boundaries and public collection limits
blockingFindings.rationale: An implementation can omit these limit checks and still satisfy the current tests.
blockingFindings.issue: The tests assert that existing relation arrays are within bounds but never create MAX_IDS_PER_ARTIFACT+1 relations or MAX_ARTIFACTS+1 descriptors. The exact MAX_ARTIFACTS fixture is rejected for response size, so it does not isolate the artifact-count limit.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add fixtures exceeding each artifact/relation bound and assert CANONICAL_RECORD_INCONSISTENT without truncation or partial output.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: An implementation can omit these limit checks and still satisfy the current tests.

blockingFindings.title: Cost inference prohibition lacks a negative regression
blockingFindings.target: R11: projects every non-null ActivityItem component from confirmed canonical facts
blockingFindings.rationale: R11 explicitly forbids estimated cost exposure, but the current assertions cannot detect inference.
blockingFindings.issue: The only usage fixture supplies cost: 0, so an implementation that infers cost from tokens or timing can pass. No fixture proves that absent provider-measured cost remains null.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add a nonzero-token/timing Activity with canonical cost absent and assert public cost is null, plus retain a fixture proving recorded provider cost is copied unchanged.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R11 explicitly forbids estimated cost exposure, but the current assertions cannot detect inference.

advisoryFindings.title: Page validation cases are incomplete
advisoryFindings.target: R9: applies the default page, exact page bounds, and finishedAt datetime filter
advisoryFindings.rationale: Existing tests already cover defaulting, representative bounds, malformed cursor input, ordering, and empty results.
advisoryFindings.improvement: Add explicit cases for non-integer and non-number limits, empty/padded cursor encodings, and invalid datetime types.
advisoryFindings.whyNonBlocking: Existing tests already cover defaulting, representative bounds, malformed cursor input, ordering, and empty results.

advisoryFindings.title: Finalized repeatability is checked only for metadata
advisoryFindings.target: R14: represents active, parked, derived-blocked, and finalized Versions as public lifecycle data
advisoryFindings.rationale: Both resources have independent success coverage, so this is an additional determinism check.
advisoryFindings.improvement: Repeat both metadata and activities queries for a finalized Version and compare complete responses.
advisoryFindings.whyNonBlocking: Both resources have independent success coverage, so this is an additional determinism check.

advisoryFindings.title: Test identifiers are reused across separate cases
advisoryFindings.target: Test names such as multiple R3, R7, R11, and R15 cases
advisoryFindings.rationale: This affects review diagnostics only and does not weaken executable coverage.
advisoryFindings.improvement: Use unique TC identifiers or descriptive suffixes for easier traceability in reports.
advisoryFindings.whyNonBlocking: This affects review diagnostics only and does not weaken executable coverage.
